title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #146 · 팔레트 통일 [틸·코랄 핑크·크림] · 동심원·매끈 · 5영역(반 고흐+몬드리안+마티스+수채+에나멜 블록) · 풀커버 · hourglass SSBBW · 정면 한 손 허리 · Russian · 배경 플라네타륨 로비 · 강남언니
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size; below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds; enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids jet-black hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Every style is rendered in one shared palette of teal, coral pink and cream, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 50% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 19%, 49%, 78% and 91% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Van Gogh style swirling thick brushstrokes rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out leaf-like shapes rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries translucent watercolour washes with pooled edges and thin drips rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries high-gloss enamel colour blocks with wet-looking highlights rendered only in teal, coral pink and cream. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass SSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy ivory leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in ivory lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a bright planetarium lobby with a polished pale floor, a curved white wall, a standard-height door and a low step, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
